phase_detail: CBA still in force; owners expected to lock out players when it expires
headline: One week before the CBA expires, the union countered the owners' cap with a plan to share all media revenue equally, and the sides remain far apart with a lockout widely expected.
latest: The MLBPA proposed that all 30 clubs split media revenue equally with no cap, while MLB raised its minimum salary offer to $1 million and said it would accept scrapping the qualifying offer. No future bargaining dates were reported.
